layers.name: Drums
layers.description: Drum kits and beats (kick/snare/hats family), from lo-fi to hard industrial.

variants.name: LofiKit
variants.label: Lo-fi kit
variants.description: Swung boom-bap kit, vinyl crackle, bitcrushed and lowpassed.

patterns.description: Busier kick, ghost snares, open hat

variants.name: Breakbeat
variants.label: Breakbeat
variants.description: Busy breakbeat: ghost snares, 16th hats, open-hat lifts.

variants.name: Industrial
variants.label: Industrial
variants.description: Driven kick, metal hits, big clap-snare, noisy 16ths.

variants.name: MinimalPulse
variants.label: Minimal pulse
variants.description: Soft deep kick, shaker 16ths, sparse rim. Calm-friendly.

variants.name: MilitarySnare
variants.label: Military snare
variants.description: Marching snare cadence with buzz rolls and flams, field bass drum.

variants.name: HardIndustrial
variants.label: Hard industrial (double-time)
variants.description: Hard electronic beat at a 180 feel: punchy driven kick, gated snare, clangs, glitch stutters.

patterns.description: Busier kick, open hats, stutter in bar 4

variants.name: Glitch
variants.label: Glitch beat
variants.description: Micro clicks, blips, reversed snares, crushed hits and stutters.

layers.name: Percussion
layers.description: Separate percussion: taiko, hand drums, timpani/orchestral, metal, distant hits.

variants.name: Taiko
variants.label: Taiko ensemble
variants.description: O-daiko and chu-daiko (3 players each), ka rim clicks, big hall.

variants.name: Darbuka
variants.label: Darbuka / hand drums
variants.description: Middle-Eastern doum/tek (maqsum), finger cymbals, frame drum.

variants.name: Orchestral
variants.label: Timpani & cymbals
variants.description: Timpani with rolls, gran cassa, suspended-cymbal swells and crash.

variants.name: MetalWorks
variants.label: Metal / anvil
variants.description: Industrial metal percussion: anvil, pipes, chains, hammer.

variants.name: DistantDrums
variants.label: Distant drums
variants.description: Far-off taiko and toms, heavily filtered, mostly reverb. Sparse.

layers.name: Bass
layers.description: Bass lines from sub pulses to 808 slides, acid and distorted double-time bass.

variants.name: SubPulse
variants.label: Sub pulse
variants.description: Sine sub, heartbeat rhythm on the chord roots.

variants.name: Driving8ths
variants.label: Driving 8ths
variants.description: Filtered saw 8ths with octave off-beats.

variants.name: DistortedReese
variants.label: Distorted reese
variants.description: Detuned saws, pumping 8th envelope, wobbling filter.

variants.name: 808Slides
variants.label: 808 slides
variants.description: Long saturated 808 sine bass with pitch glides, half-time phrasing.

variants.name: Acid
variants.label: Acid bass
variants.description: Resonant 303-style line with accents and slides, filter sweep, driven.

variants.name: PluckBass
variants.label: Plucked synth bass
variants.description: Short saw/square pluck with sub, syncopated 16ths.

variants.name: AggroBass
variants.label: Aggressive distorted bass
variants.description: Double-time distorted saw stack with growl filter, phrygian b2.

layers.name: Pad / Atmos
layers.description: Pads and atmospheres: synth pads, drones, choir, wind, granular textures.

variants.name: DarkPad
variants.label: Dark pad
variants.description: Supersaw chords, breathing lowpass, wide chorus, long reverb.

variants.name: CinematicDrone
variants.label: Cinematic drone
variants.description: A/E pedal drone, air band, shimmer swells.

patterns.description: Shimmer on bars 1 and 5, faster breathing

variants.name: CyberStabs
variants.label: Cyber chord stabs
variants.description: Syncopated chord stabs with ping-pong delay.

variants.name: DarkChoir
variants.label: Dark choir
variants.description: Four-part formant choir, aah to ooh, cathedral reverb.

patterns.description: Crescendo with high top note in bars 7-8

variants.name: DesertWind
variants.label: Desert wind
variants.description: Drifting resonant wind bands, gusts, whistles, low rumble.

variants.name: Granular
variants.label: Granular texture
variants.description: Cloud of short tonal grains on the chord tones, breathing density.

layers.name: Strings / Brass
layers.description: Synthesized orchestral layer: low string ostinatos, dark strings, brass, tremolo.

variants.name: StringOstinato
variants.label: Low string ostinato
variants.description: Spiccato celli + basses, 16ths in 3-3-3-3-4 accents.

variants.name: DarkStrings
variants.label: Dark strings
variants.description: Low divisi strings, con sordino, hairpin swells per chord.

variants.name: BrassSwells
variants.label: Brass swells
variants.description: Horns + trombones + tuba, crescendo on every chord.

variants.name: BrassHits
variants.label: Brass hits & braams
variants.description: Distorted low brass braams on downbeats, short brass/string stabs.

variants.name: TremoloStrings
variants.label: High tremolo strings
variants.description: Violins tremolando on chord tones with hairpins.

variants.name: Duduk
variants.label: Duduk-style reed

variants.name: NeyFlute
variants.label: Ney flute
variants.description: Breathy end-blown flute, high register, long reverb.

variants.name: WarmLead
variants.label: Warm dark synth lead

patterns.description: Low melody with run in bar 8

variants.name: IndustrialRiff
variants.label: Industrial synth riff
variants.description: Double-time distorted synth riff, phrygian b2/b5.

variants.name: SynthPulse
variants.label: Synth pulse ostinato
variants.description: Filtered square 16th pulses on root/fifth/octave.

layers.name: Guitar

variants.name: PalmMuteChug
variants.label: Palm-mute chug
variants.description: Double-tracked high-gain palm-muted power chords.

variants.name: AmbientSwells
variants.label: Ambient swells
variants.description: Volume-swelled notes into long delay and reverb.

variants.name: LeadRiff
variants.label: Distorted lead riff
variants.description: High-gain single-note riff, double-tracked.

variants.name: BaritoneTwang
variants.label: Baritone twang

variants.name: TremoloPicking
variants.label: Tremolo picking
variants.description: 32nd-note tremolo-picked dark melody, double-tracked.

variants.name: HeavyChug
variants.label: Heavy detuned chug

layers.name: FX / Texture

variants.name: RadioStatic

variants.name: RisersPulses

variants.name: TensionTexture
variants.label: Tension texture
variants.description: Ticking clock, metallic drone, rumble.

variants.name: Impacts
variants.label: Impacts & downlifters

variants.name: CommsData
